test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. A glimpse of its rich cultural heritage can be found through the great monuments and other historical sites it has.

B. India has a vast cultural and linguistic diversity which make the country culturally rich.

C. These monuments and historical sites are the symbols of India’s diversity.

D. Several historical sites and monuments are identified as UN Heritage Sites.
solution:
The correct answer is '**BACD**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• **Sentence B** will be the first sentence because it introduces the topic of** India's cultural diversity and richness**, which serves as the main idea of the paragraph. 
 
• **Sentence A **provides specific details that support the main idea by mentioning the great monuments and historical sites in India.
 
• **Sentence C** follows logically from sentence A by identifying these monuments and historical sites as symbols of India's diversity.
 
• **Sentence D** provides additional information that reinforces the main idea by mentioning that some of these historical sites and monuments have been recognized as UN Heritage Sites.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sequence:__** *India has a vast cultural and linguistic diversity which make the country culturally rich. A glimpse of its rich cultural heritage can be found through the great monuments and other historical sites it has. These monuments and historical sites are the symbols of India’s diversity. Several historical sites and monuments are identified as UN Heritage Sites.*
